entities.summary: Harrison Grant Holmes is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Atlanta Braves of Major League Baseball (MLB). He was drafted by the Los Angeles Dodgers in the first round of the 2014 MLB draft. He made his MLB debut in 2024 with the Braves.
